answer: New agents pay 100 crystal tokens for admission. At each epoch, they provide a unique signal from a glacier to prove identity. If signals are duplicated, a 100 token fine is imposed. A cloned signal incurs an additional 150 token charge, offsetting the original 100 tokens. Mass cloning yields a 50 token loss per clone, while a valid signal retains the full 100 token stake. Verifiers assess signal uniqueness at epoch close, penalizing non-unique signals with a 100 token deduction.
